findings.description: Every issue found. Empty array is a valid and often correct answer.

file.description: Repo-relative path, exactly as it appears in the diff.

line_start.description: Line number in the CURRENT (post-change) file. Verify by reading the file, not by counting diff hunks.

line_end.description: Last relevant line; equal to line_start for a single line.

severity.description: critical = data loss, security breach, or production outage. high = incorrect behaviour users will hit. medium = real bug on an uncommon path, or a maintenance trap. low = worth knowing, not worth blocking.

category.description: Short kebab-case tag, e.g. race-condition, missing-authz, breaking-api-change, n-plus-one, unhandled-rejection.

title.description: One line, under 90 chars, states the defect not the remedy.

why_it_matters.description: The concrete failure. Name the trigger condition and the observable consequence. No generic risk language.

evidence.description: The specific code construct you read that proves this, with file:line references. If you cannot cite it, do not report it.

suggested_fix.description: Minimal concrete change. Omit rather than guess.

confidence.description: 0.9+ = you read the code and the defect is certain. 0.7 = very likely but depends on a caller you could not fully verify. 0.5 = plausible, needs human judgement. Below 0.5 = do not report.
